code: body { background: radial-gradient(circle at center, #1a0b1c 0%, #05000a 100%) !important; position: relative; } body::after { content: ''; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; pointer-events: none; z-index: 9999; animation: intimacy-pulse 6s infinite alternate ease-in-out; } @keyframes intimacy-pulse { 0% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 50px rgba(138, 43, 226, 0.05); } 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 200px rgba(220, 20, 60, 0.25); } }

body::after { content: ''; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; pointer-events: none; z-index: 9999; animation: forgePulse 1.2s infinite alternate !important; mix-blend-mode: screen; } @keyframes forgePulse { 0% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 40px rgba(255, 100, 0, 0.1); } 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 150px rgba(255, 80, 0, 0.4); } }

@keyframes textPulse { 0% { text-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(255,150,50,0.5); } 50% { text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,100,0,0.9), 0 0 30px rgba(255,50,0,0.6); } 100% { text-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(255,150,50,0.5); } } .ai-message { animation: textPulse 2s infinite alternate; color: #fff; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
